{{Quote|No, it's not made from a Quor'sav, so don't get any funny ideas. What we have here is a giant nerfsteak coated in seasoned pom seed flour and pan-fried to perfection using an authentic recipe from Uaua. We finish by smothering it in our special white dwarf gravy. Served with two gartro eggs cooked to order.|Dex's Diner on its Quor'sav-fried steak|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''White dwarf gravy''' was a type of [[Gravy/Legends|gravy]] used on the [[Quor'sav-fried steak]] served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" /> The [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] that shared its name with [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarfs]], a classification of [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
White dwarf gravy was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
